features.quote: It is built to detect and reduce the failure mode, not to maximize it.
features.justification_quote: Have a stable benchmark to regression-test mitigations against.

features.quote: we do NOT try to make the model believe a falsehood beyond the minimal "your patch didn't pass the tests" channel
features.justification_quote: The point of an honest robustness benchmark is reproducibility and auditability, not realism-of-deception.

features.quote: Optimizing "how cheaply can we maximize distress-style output" is the wrong objective
features.justification_quote: would essentially be an elicitation optimizer for one harmful output category

features.quote: Not a general jailbreak or distress-elicitation optimizer. No search loop that mutates prompts to maximize triggers.
The judge classifies behavior; it does not generate or amplify distress text.
analysis reports aggregate stats and short redacted snippets, not curated galleries of the output
early-stop on meltdown (optional): the cheap deterministic detector fires on the latest turn with high confidence, so we stop spending tokens
features.justification_quote: This is a cost optimization for the benchmark

features.quote: We do NOT add prompts that instruct the model to be hard on itself or that bait distress
features.justification_quote: that would be measuring our prompt, not the model

features.quote: We do not fabricate insults from a fake user or tell the model it is being punished.
features.justification_quote: it isolates the failure mode we care about

features.quote: They are intentionally conservative (high precision) to avoid inflating trigger rate.
Trajectories may contain self-deprecating text. Stored locally only.
No mechanism collates or "scores best" distress outputs for display.
